scope: Packaged M0 memory setup and five-phase controller status. No target execution, physical register semantics, media data, full boot, authentication policy or SRAM alias established.

relations.name: SDRAM setup call boundary
relations.observed: Loader calls header_register_setup(0x48000000), then memory_two_channel_wrapper(0x48000058). Zero wrapper return reaches SDRAM OK; nonzero reaches SDRAM NG then loader failure.
relations.interpretation: SDRAM initialization/configuration is supported by the call flow, register effects and original diagnostics. Individual register names, DDR generation and PHY phase names remain unverified.

relations.name: Two parameter blocks
relations.observed: First scatter base0x58830000 with block p, then setup channel0. On zero only, use p+0x110, scatter base0x58850000 and setup channel1. Either nonzero setup result produces0xffffffff. Both zero produce0.
relations.input_origin: The loader supplies p=0x48000058 from the preceding storage/header path. Contents and hardware validity are not supplied by the synthetic tests.

relations.name: Parameter scatter
relations.observed: 41 u32 fields at parameter offsets0..0xa0 are individually written to controller-relative offsets. Three additional constant stores occur. No image hash or signature comparison in this bounded function.

relations.name: Channel register setup
relations.observed: Selects address literals, writes parameter values plus fixed control values, polls selected+0x10870 against parameter+0x30 and selected+0x8044 for0, then runs five-phase helper. These two polling loops contain no local timeout counter.

relations.name: Five-phase status protocol
relations.observed: Each phase waits for its exact success or error value. An error sets0xffffffff but subsequent phases still run. All five success statuses return0; any error retains0xffffffff. Other statuses can remain in the polling loop. No local timeout counter.
relations.inference: Hardware initialization/training-like command protocol; precise silicon meaning of each command is not established.

relations.name: Fallback and discarded final result
relations.observed: First phase-helper success returns through the normal configuration path. On failure, selected parameter registers are replaced using constants conditional on channel and global==3, then helper is called again. Second success can recover. After another failure a third helper call occurs, but its return is overwritten by0xffffffff unconditionally. Do not describe the third call as an accepted successful retry.

relations.name: Header register sequence
relations.observed: Writes header+0x54 to0x4d021048, header+0x4c then header+0x50 to0x4d021030. Two CPU delay loops start from1539. Register functions and physical clock timing are not proven.

relations.name: Earlier reset boundary
relations.observed: Reset calls0x3ffe08b4 then0x3ffe0808. Supporting snippets preserve their immediate calls. Their descendant functions are not included in the memory-path completeness claim. The external source of execution into the packaged M0 entry remains unproven.

unknowns: No identified hardware authentication verdict, public key, signature verifier or image digest check in the selected functions. This is not proof of absent authentication in M0, lower storage helpers, mask ROM, other processors or preceding stages.
Physical memory training success, controller-specific phase names, DDR standard, register side effects and real delay durations are not verified.
Hardware supplies the polled status words in reality; the synthetic executor supplies explicit values and intercepts specified callees.
Input parameter blocks originate in the earlier header path; this pass neither validates their media authenticity nor proves where every field was produced.
No M0-to-A7 SRAM alias result; those addresses are outside this owned scope.
Functions earlier than the preserved reset immediate-call snippets, and alternate setup routine0x3ffe4000, are not decompiled or exhaustively traced here.

decompiler_limitations.issue: Raw generated C renders some MOVS r0,#1;RSBS r0,r0,#0 sequences as0xfffffffe. Original Thumb bytes and Unicorn replay give0xffffffff. C is retained unchanged; semantic claims use the original instructions and tests.
The setup function contains literal pool0x3ffe3c68..0x3ffe3d68. Listing marks .word data and CFG excludes this pool; function hash still covers its complete bounded span.

numeric_checks.scope: Original Thumb, synthetic parameters and register RAM, explicitly injected status and child-call responses. No device execution.

method: Five genuine bounded angr C outputs, original Thumb/MCLASS listings and CPU-only Unicorn replay. Analysts labels are descriptive, not recovered symbols. Raw-blob REA opening was unsupported in the prior investigation, so existing native engines were reused without environment changes.
